heuristics: Avoid planning a push when the box is adjacent to a corner or wall that creates an immediate deadlock after the push; ensure a clear, unobstructed path exists for the box to move to a non-blocking area before attempting a push.

If a push requires the player to take a long detour around obstacles (long path_to_push) that increases the chance of intermediate deadlocks, prefer alternative pushes that minimize required walking distance to the push position.

Do not sequence pushes that result in the target box occupying a corner or encapsulated area with walls or boxes on two sides; prefer pushes that leave the box with at least one free perpendicular escape route.

When multiple boxes are in play, confirm that the destination cell for the moving box is currently free and will not trap another box immediately after the move; avoid synchronized pushes that create cascading blockages.

Limit push attempts to situations where the required_player_position is reachable without crossing through a space that is simultaneously needed to reposition other boxes; avoid blocking the agent’s own path during the approach to a push.
